What I do

How I can help

Blockchain Infrastructure

Substrate runtimes and custom FRAME pallets, Layer 1 chains, EVM compatibility, tokenomics and cross-chain interoperability, built in Rust.

Backend & API Development

Fast, reliable REST and real-time APIs in Rust with Axum, backed by Postgres and Redis, with attention to authentication, concurrency and data integrity.

Smart Contracts

Solidity contracts built on OpenZeppelin standards (ERC-721, ERC-777, ERC-1155), tested with Foundry or Hardhat, with Chainlink integrations where needed.

Web3 & DeFi Applications

End-to-end dApps such as NFT and real-estate marketplaces, token swaps and DAOs, from the contract layer to the user interface.
